district.name: Synthetic District D-33
district.label: Dubai-inspired synthetic district
district.disclaimer: Research prototype — synthetic/benchmark infrastructure data. Not connected to any utility; no real Dubai assets are represented.

electrical.benchmark: IEEE 33-bus distribution test feeder (Baran & Wu, 1989) via pandapower.networks.case33bw()
assumptions: Bus numbering is 1-based (benchmark convention); pandapower indices are number − 1.
Line impedances and nominal loads are the published Baran–Wu values; line routes in the 3D district are illustrative.
Thermal ratings are synthetic (the benchmark defines none).
Every line carries a switch; ties are normally open. Remote-controlled switches can be operated by the recovery planner.
Pump electrical demand is computed from the hydraulic solution (P = ρgQH/η) and added to the host bus load.
Service connections are a synthetic mapping (≈2.5 kW per residential connection; large customers counted individually).

feeders.name: Feeder F3
feeders.description: Lateral from bus 6, buses 26–33 (west district: hospital, PS-2)

facilities.name: Substation S1
facilities.description: Primary 12.66 kV bus of the IEEE 33-bus benchmark (slack/external grid). Feeder breaker and remote switching are dispatched from here.

facilities.name: City Hospital
facilities.description: Critical facility. Electrical life-safety loads ride through on a standby genset; water service depends on the West-zone network (PS-2 + Tank T2).

facilities.name: Emergency Operations Centre
facilities.description: Coordinates district emergency response. Supplied from Feeder F2; East-zone water.

facilities.name: Pumping Station PS-1
facilities.description: Lifts desalinated supply from R1 into the East pressure zone. Electrical demand computed from P = ρgQH/η.

facilities.name: Pumping Station PS-2
facilities.description: Lifts desalinated supply from R1 into the West pressure zone (hospital). Supplied from the far end of Feeder F3.

facilities.name: Elevated Tank T1
facilities.description: East-zone elevated storage. Floats on the zone hydraulic grade line.

facilities.name: Elevated Tank T2
facilities.description: West-zone elevated storage. Its usable volume sets how long the West zone rides through a PS-2 outage.

facilities.name: Desalination Supply R1
facilities.description: Ground storage fed by the regional desalination transmission main. Modelled as a fixed-head reservoir; powered outside the district (not part of the 33-bus model).

facilities.name: District Cooling Plant DC-1
facilities.description: Large non-critical chiller load (Baran–Wu bus 30: 200 kW, 600 kVAr). Shedding it frees significant voltage headroom on Feeder F3.

facilities.name: Retail Mall
facilities.description: Large commercial load on Feeder F4 (420 kW).

facilities.name: Office Complex
facilities.description: Large commercial load at the end of Feeder F4 (420 kW); tie switch to Feeder F3 nearby.

assumptions: Boundary pipes BV-1…BV-4 between the West and East zones are normally closed isolation valves.
Pipe lengths follow the district street geometry; Hazen–Williams C = 120.
Demand nodes follow a synthetic Dubai summer diurnal pattern; values are not measured data.
Pipe depths in the 3D view are exaggerated for visibility.
